practiceHelp.title: How to play 2048
practiceHelp.subtitle: Learn how to move, merge, and score, then try it on the practice board.
practiceHelp.goal: Merge matching numbers on a 4×4 board to make 2048, then keep playing for a higher score. Reaching 2048 does not end the game.
practiceHelp.controls: Use the arrow keys or WASD on a computer. On a phone or tablet, swipe up, down, left, or right on the board. All tiles move in the same direction.
practiceHelp.movement: The game starts with two tiles. After each move that changes the board, a new 2 or 4 appears in an empty cell. If nothing moves, no new tile appears.
practiceHelp.score: Two matching tiles combine into a larger one. Each tile can merge only once per move. The value of each newly merged tile is added to your score; merging 2 + 2 adds 4 points.
practiceHelp.finish: The game ends and saves your score when there are no empty cells and no merges are possible in any direction. Practice has no time limit. Refreshing, leaving, or restarting does not save an unfinished game.
practiceHelp.returnToGame: If you opened this page from practice, switch back to your original practice tab to continue that game.
